title.zh: 找出第 K 小的数对距离

desc.zh: 从数对手算到滑动窗口计数与答案二分。
desc.en: From hand-counted pairs to window counting and binary search.

complexity: O(n log n + n log(W+1)) time; O(n) space, W=max(nums)-min(nums)

concepts.name: Pair distance counting
concepts.description: Count a contiguous block of left endpoints for each sorted right endpoint.

concepts.name: Binary search on distance
concepts.description: Find the first threshold with at least k pairs.
